en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.summary: Information and Broadcasting Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman announced that the government is monitoring civil servants to identify those with ties to the banned Awami League. The government intends to utilize its internal mechanisms to manage the matter.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/business/lo.title: Minimum wage board meeting rescheduled for November 23
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/business/lo.summary: The Minimum Wage Board has rescheduled its third meeting to November 23 following an initial postponement due to unavoidable circumstances. The board is tasked with addressing garment worker demands for a Tk 32,000 minimum wage, a significant increase over previous proposals. Workers have been protesting for weeks to press for better pay amidst rising living costs.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.title: Police disperse garment worker protests in Dhaka and Savar
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.summary: Garment workers held protests in Mirpur and blocked the Dhaka-Aricha Highway in Savar on Tuesday to demand a Tk 30,000 minimum wage. Law enforcement, including police and BGB, used sound grenades and tear gas to disperse crowds and clear roads. The demonstrations caused significant traffic disruptions and led to clashes between protesters and security personnel.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.title: Tensions rise as Awami League activists protest against NCP leaders in UK
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.summary: Awami League supporters in the UK have staged protests and attempted to harass leaders of the National Citizens Party (NCP), including Nahid Islam, during their overseas visits. While NCP leaders face resistance following their role in the July uprising, other parties like the BNP and Jamaat-e-Islami have not encountered similar opposition. Security measures were increased for these events.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/internation.title: Hakeem Jeffries nears nomination for US House speaker
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/internation.summary: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries is expected to be nominated as the Democratic candidate for speaker of the US House of Representatives on Wednesday. If successful in the upcoming congressional vote, he would become the first Black speaker in US history. Jeffries currently faces no declared challengers within his party, though he navigates internal demands from the progressive flank.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/business/lo.title: Bangladesh faces rising foreign debt repayment pressure
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/business/lo.summary: Bangladesh is managing significant foreign debt repayment obligations, with costs projected to reach $7.6 billion by 2030. Adviser Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir noted the government is seeking to diversify borrowing and boost domestic investment to mitigate these financial burdens. The country aims to highlight the economic challenges facing developing nations at upcoming international summits.

en|https://www.dw.com/en/trump-kicks-off.summary: US President Donald Trump is visiting the Philippines to attend a Quad group meeting and hold trilateral talks with Russia and China. The tour follows significant domestic setbacks for his administration. Protesters have gathered in Manila to demonstrate against the President's arrival and specific US policies.

en|https://www.dw.com/en/japan-scrambles.title: Japan deploys fighter jets to intercept suspected Russian aircraft
en|https://www.dw.com/en/japan-scrambles.summary: Japan scrambled fighter jets on Tuesday after two suspected Russian aircraft entered its sovereign airspace near Okinoshima. Tokyo lodged a formal protest, labeling the incursion a security threat. This incident follows similar Russian aerial activity reported by South Korea and occurs amidst already strained diplomatic relations between Japan and Russia.

en|https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates.title: Ukrainian strikes target Kerch bridge as Russia hits Kyiv infrastructure
en|https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates.summary: A Ukrainian drone strike on the Kerch bridge has suspended traffic and caused significant damage to the link between occupied Crimea and Russia. Simultaneously, Russian strikes targeted bridges in Kyiv and killed two people in Crimea. These attacks occur as negotiators discuss potential future talks to end the ongoing war.
